pictures.name: SL1-The-Seeker
pictures.prompt: A quiet forest monastery grove in ancient India at late afternoon. Vacchagotta (a lean wandering seeker of about forty, long dark hair tied up, a short beard, a faded ochre-grey wanderer’s cloth, an earnest, searching face) approaches along a path and sits down respectfully before the Buddha (shown in the traditional respectful way: serene face, short dark curls, gentle downcast eyes, a simple saffron robe over one shoulder), who sits on a low seat beneath a tree. Gold light slanting through leaves, deep blue shade. Contemplative sacred oil painting, one tall 9:16 picture, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow quiet mood, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.
